name: LIMIT_EXECUTION_CASH_CORRECTION_V1
change: Pure limit entry cash costs equal modeled trading fee only; no adverse entry slippage charged beyond requested limit. Qualification and sizing still reserve the original conservative fee/slippage budget. No signal, TP,SL,timing,rank or risk parameter tuning.
fee_sensitivity: Same corrected base executions and quantities. Reprice cash flows only, without selecting new trades or resizing. Not an independently re-simulated portfolio at new fees; margin feasibility reported.
fee_role: Only INTRABAR resting LIMIT entry uses maker scenario; OPEN marketable entry and all modeled exits use taker. No personal or pair-specific fees verified. Scenarios are economic sensitivity, not actual account rates.
no_search: Two strategy hypotheses remain the only trials; this corrects accounting and quantifies fee uncertainty, without a third setup or threshold sweep.
